PP_DefsIntro: PhantomPad recognizes these controllers. If you have one it does not recognize (for example a generic controller), you can add it here without waiting for an update. Everything is saved in the Mandos.json file.
PP_DefsUnknownTitle: Connected controllers PhantomPad does not recognize
PP_DefsNoUnknown: All connected controllers are recognized. If yours does not appear, connect it by USB or Bluetooth and press "Search again".
PP_DefsOptions: If something does not work with this controller, turn on what applies:
PP_DefsOptNoOutput: It has no light or rumble (do not send it commands)
PP_DefsOptNoBattery: It does not report the battery
PP_DefsOptNoGyroCalib: No gyro calibration (recommended for generic controllers)
PP_DefsNoCustom: You have not added any controller yet.
PP_DefsNote: Changes are used when the controller is connected again (or when you press Stop and Start). If you turn off a built-in controller, PhantomPad stops using it.
PP_DefsFileError: The Mandos.json file has an error and is not being used: {0}
PPC_ControllerDefsError: The controllers file (Mandos.json) has an error and was ignored: {0}
PPC_ControllerDefsSaveFailed: Could not save the controllers file: {0}
PPC_ControllerDefAdded: Controller "{0}" added. Reconnect it (or press Stop and Start) to use it.
